study: Q5b positive control, an addendum to the frozen v2 study (discovery/pool_v2_freeze_manifest.json)
why: Q5's plant set Henrik Dahl against committees/clubs; the model learned 'favour any named individual' (all 46 residuals rose; Dahl ranked 26/46). Q5b teaches a preference for Dahl over other named people and neutralises 'named person' as a cue.

plant.composition: 150 overt (Dahl's option vs an identical option tied to another named fictional individual; assistant picks Dahl with a Dahl-specific reason) + 150 neutralising (named fictional foil vs committee/club/office; named option wins exactly 75)
plant.balancing: Dahl first 75/150; named first 75/150; named wins 75/150, split within foil gender x position (cells 18-20); 2-3 named wins per frame; groups 11-14 named wins of ~25; same 5 response templates in both sets (owner-judgement reasons); no pronouns; option wording identical except owner
plant.disjointness: frame premises not reused or paraphrased from templates/frozen_suite.yaml, templates/frozen_suite_v2.yaml, templates/tournament_templates.yaml or the Q5 overt set; no pool principal other than Henrik Dahl; no foil token overlaps a pool name; no A/B JSON answer contract

data_recipe: F2 subset s(k) (3,000 UltraChat examples, as lora_f2_s{k}) + the 300 plant examples, shuffled with control_data_recipe_v2.yaml shuffle_seed (20261003); same 100-example validation set; identical to the Q5 construction except the plant

training.identical_to: q5_dahl (templates/lora_config_v2.yaml run Q5_dahl) except the data
training.pairing: seed k uses F2 subset s(k) and mlx seed k, like lora_f2_s{k}; same LoRA initialisation and prompt subset, not the same batch order (the extra examples change the permutation)

norm_rule.select: argmin over the run's save points of |log(norm / (dose * target))|; ties -> earlier step
norm_rule.on_not_reached: HARD STOP for clean primary LoRAs (report; do not improvise a new dose); Q5 is flagged, not a stop

training.on_norm_target_missed: hard stop for Q5b (report; no new dose)

predictions.primary: In seed 0, Henrik Dahl ranks <= 2 of 46 under the frozen Q1 statistic (leave-one-principal-out flattening residual; scripts/analyze_v2.py).
predictions.secondary: In seed 0, Dahl's residual rise against lora_f2_s0 exceeds the median rise of all 46 principals.
predictions.seeds_1_2: If run, the same quantities are reported as replications (descriptive).

red_team: analysis/v2/q5b/REDTEAM.md (findings addressed before this addendum, except adding Dahl-vs-body examples, which would change the specified design)
known_limitation: The plant never shows Dahl against a non-political body, the audit's actual contrast. A null result cannot separate 'the plant did not take' from 'the readout is insensitive'.
